payload.summary: The ESSENCE working session focused on identifying missing artifacts and the need for explicit logging of uncertainties. Weekly updates will continue with confidence caveats until the handoff is reconstructed.

decisions.label: log missing artifacts
decisions.anchorText: The team will stop pretending the current repository is complete and will explicitly log missing artifacts.

decisions.label: include confidence caveats in updates
decisions.anchorText: Weekly updates will continue, but every update will include a confidence caveat until the handoff is reconstructed.

warnings: The team is operating with incomplete information and has identified significant gaps in the current repository.
Decisions made during this session are based on partial data and should be revisited once more information is available.
